startersHint: A starter sets how close a colour must be to the background to be removed. You can change it below.
honest: This works by matching colours, so it suits a plain, even background. It is not made for busy backgrounds like a street or a room, and it cannot tell a subject from a background of the same colour.
pickHint: Pick a photo or scan from your phone or computer. Large pictures are reduced to 1600 pixels on the longest side. It is not uploaded.
previewLabel: Your picture with the background removed
colourAuto: Background colour found from the edges
tapHint: If the wrong part is removed, tap the background in the picture to choose its colour.
fileFailed: That picture could not be opened. Try a JPG, PNG or WebP file.
saveFailed: The picture could not be saved.
toleranceHint: Raise it if some of the background is left. Lower it if parts of your subject disappear.
edgesOnly: Only remove background touching the edges
edgesOnlyHint: Keeps a white shirt, a hole in the middle of an object or white writing on the subject. Turn it off for a signature or text on paper.
shrinkHint: Eats a little into the subject to lose a pale rim left by the old background.
smoothHint: Softens the cut so it looks less jagged.
fillClearHint: A transparent PNG keeps the see-through background, so you can place it over any other picture.
fillColourHint: A filled picture is saved as a JPG.
pngNote: PNG keeps the transparency. Some apps show transparent areas as white or black until you place the picture on something.
jpgNote: Saved as a JPG with the colour behind it.
notSaved: Your picture is never uploaded. Only your settings are remembered on this device, not the picture.
